bluf: SEO-Küche is a German online marketing agency, on the record since 2009, selling SEO, GEO, SEA, web design and local listing to SMEs, with no office listed. It is doing what its record shows: a high volume SEO case book (44 case studies on its own site read, 614 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days) with a GEO agency page and prompt research on top. Where it is going the record does not say: no dated moves, news, jobs or partners. The one thing a rival should know: it sells AI search visibility with no llms.txt, and its Transparency Center lookup was blocked, so its own paid search practice is unverified.
doing:
SEO-Küche positions itself as an online marketing agency for visibility in Google and AI search, turning SEO, SEA, GEO and web design into measurable sales since 2009: in plain words, an SME search shop that has added generative engine optimisation to its SEO line and sells the mix as sales rather than traffic. Its headline claim is a 4.9 rating from 98 reviews, with cases citing +2,600% top 10 placements and +129% organic traffic, both the agency's own claims from its case pages.

The sold mix leads with SEO (scored 3: the meta names SEO first, an SEO agency page and six city SEO pages) and AI Search / GEO (scored 3: the title pairs Google with AI, a GEO agency page with prompt research, a Local GEO guide). Five core lines sit at 2: Content & Digital PR (a content marketing page in four city variants and a linkmarketing page covering backlink analysis), Data & Measurement (a Webanalyse page offering Matomo and Google Analytics work, plus the EWE AG Jentis and Matomo case), Local (a Local Listing page keeping business data consistent across 40+ directories), Paid Search (an SEA agency page, the SEA-Effizienzcheck, four SEA and two Google Ads city pages) and Web & Product (a new website or shop offered on the homepage, with pages in seven city variants). Three proprietary products are listed: Online-Marketing Plus, a bundled full service package; BewerberPlus, a digital recruiting product for SMEs; and the SEA-Effizienzcheck. The partners list is empty.

AI posture: it sells GEO for ChatGPT and AI search visibility, including prompt research and Local GEO, plus an AI agency page applying AI across its services; AI automation scores 1 with no evidence note, and the sitemap holds 22 AI URLs.

The moves list is empty, and the deepening pass found no news, jobs or ATS. Pricing signals: free consultations, a free SEO check, an SEO audit sold under a packages path and an SEA efficiency check, with no prices shown; the Horus P5 read is unknown. Conspicuously absent for a search and AI visibility agency of its kind: partner badges, dated moves, an employee count, B2B & ABM and Retail Media at 0, Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV at 1 with no notes, and an audited AI visibility product.
clients:
The record types the client base as SMB across twelve verticals, including ecommerce and retail, insurance and finance, pharma and healthcare, automotive and mobility (car dealers, driving schools), trades (Handwerk) and legal services. The home market is Germany and no office is listed.

The needs read lists 19 clients, 6 observed and 13 names only. Four observed rows are organic demand: schweng.eu (organic traffic up 129%), YouFlake (452% more top 10 keywords), Willenbacher (top 10 rankings from 1 to 27) and sanft.ch (organic clicks up 41,54%), all case studies dated 2025-10-23. LEXR Tech AG is paid performance and data and measurement: its case study dated 2026-02-23 describes a tracking check with optimisation in GTM, Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads. EWE AG is coded N0, engagement named only, although its case study dated 2026-03-02 describes tracking configurations in Jentis and Matomo, error fixes, user training and consulting: measurement work the needs read did not code.

The 13 names only rows are SachsenEnergie AG, Hosokawa Alpine AG, Munich Business School, Aschendorff, medica mondiale e.V., Klasse2000, Aalberts, Beissbarth, Buchalik Brömmekamp, Beautykaufhaus and FensterMaxx24, slugs with nothing about the work, plus Schrankplaner (coded organic demand from a title citing 206% more organic clicks) and Starnberg Ammersee (coded N0 although its title cites 25% more organic users). For the slug only names the need is inferred from the sold mix, SEO first. Further 2025-10-23 case titles name sites outside the needs rows (weigla.com, Umzüge Brandlmeier, transporte-deml.de, Spa-Vital, schwarz-parker.de, Ruperti-Apotheke, Rosa Bridal Fashion), every one an SEO ranking or traffic claim.

The observed mix is organic demand at a 0.758 share, paid performance 0.161 and data and measurement 0.081. No client is shared with another tracked agency. The Horus read places the mix best for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), driven by AI Search / GEO, and most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out). It is likely, with moderate confidence, that this SME book, sold on ranking and traffic percentages, will ask for citation and AI answer numbers next, which its GEO page sells but no audited product in the record supports.
house:
Say and do: the Radar tested three sold lines and 1 of 2 decidable tests came through. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 22 AI topic URLs in its sitemap. Paid Search is unknown: the Transparency Center lookup was blocked. Publishing cadence is corroborated: the sitemap lists 1463 URLs, 614 updated in 90 days and 617 in 365, and the prominence note counts 674 blog URLs with 614 content changes in 90 days plus a lexicon, guides, whitepapers and a podcast; the latest blog dates run to 2026-09-28.

The stack is WordPress with GTM and Complianz; no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack were detected, and no AI crawlers are blocked. LinkedIn advertising status is none: 0 ads match the name query across all advertisers and the first results page shows 0 cards. Social links cover LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Threads. The one flagged gap is the missing llms.txt on a sold AI search line.
market:
The Horus read scores SEO-Küche at a tailwind index of 15.5, band Favored, the sold mix at 16:45 dusk (Atum) on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.278), driven by AI Search / GEO at +2 and Content & Digital PR at +1 with SEO at -1, and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them, net 0.199), driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search. Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out, net -0.123), where SEO, Paid Search and Content & Digital PR each count -1, and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two) through Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV. Best scenario fit is The Toll Road at 39/100. Moves: making P4; partial on P1, P3 and P7; absent on P2, P6 and P8; unknown on P5 pricing.

The Monsoon read: index 64.7, band Onshore wind; migration 58.7 against displacement 70.7. The verdict puts 59 of the index on the sold mix, with SEO (12) and Web & Product (8) the most movable hours, and sends the work 35% to South and Southeast Asia and 55% to Eastern Europe, all inferred from the SMB client type: no hub office and no onshore claim is listed.
openings:
The strongest opening is the GEO line. SEO-Küche leads with AI Search / GEO at a score of 3 and publishes no llms.txt, and the Horus P1 read finds no audited AI visibility product (tracking, scorecard, citation share) behind the GEO agency page and its 22 AI topic URLs. It is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival showing a citation share number for German SME queries takes the GEO conversation from its SEO clients. Falsifier: an llms.txt at seo-kueche.de or a published AI visibility tracking product with client figures.

Second, the paid line is unverified: the Transparency Center lookup was blocked, LinkedIn shows 0 ads, and P8 is absent. There is a roughly even chance, low confidence, that LEXR Tech AG, its one observed paid performance row, would hear an assistant ad test with holdouts.

Third, pricing: no public model (P5 unknown), only a free SEO check and the SEA-Effizienzcheck as lead magnets. With a Monsoon displacement read of 70.7 (inferred), an outcome priced or offshore delivered offer on SEO (12) and Web & Product (8) hours very likely undercuts it line by line. Fourth, 13 of its 19 clients are names only, including SachsenEnergie AG, Hosokawa Alpine AG and Munich Business School: the work is undescribed, which is a question to put to them.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO line that carries 5 of its 6 observed rows, while above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and makes the absent P8 test costlier.

I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1, its best placed judgment.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and its timing, with pricing below $20 CPM signalling supply outrunning demand, which bears on the KJ2 tailwind its GEO and SEA pairing depends on.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would sharpen the KJ6 exposure of its hour based SEO and SEA mix.
No dated move sits in the record; the follow up is whether more tracking cases join EWE AG (2026-03-02) and LEXR Tech AG (2026-02-23), which would show the data line growing past its 0.081 share.
The next Radar compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile and the 2026-09-29 own site read.
